## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] This PR is focused and linked to an issue.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met; no unrelated work is included.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests/checks pass, and results above are accurate.
- [ ] API, architecture, database, or user documentation is updated as needed.
- [ ] Authorization and failure cases are covered for security-sensitive paths.
- [ ] No `.env` files, credentials, tokens, personal data, or generated build output are included.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a short recording where useful.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migrations include compatibility and rollback guidance.
